summary: Unpinned git dependency to author-controlled libsignal fork resolves install-time code from a mutable source
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as a bare GitHub reference (`github:wanzchil/libsignal-node`) with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever bytes currently sit at the HEAD of that author-controlled repository and executes any lifecycle scripts contained inside, rather than fetching an immutable tarball from the npm registry. Any future push to that repository changes the code installers of this version receive. The static match on `lib/Utils/generics.js:403` (`ping`/`GET` tokens) corresponds to a Baileys-style WhatsApp socket keepalive/HTTP handler and is not independently indicative of exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
